$comment: The English of the texts written in the code (src/server/i18n.js, src/client/i18n.js), under the Polish text itself, so Polish stays the only source. {name} stands for what the code fills in, the same in both languages. A Polish noun after a number has its three forms as one key, "punkt|punkty|punktów", and English its two, "point|points". tools/i18n-check.mjs lists what is missing.
